name: Takuhai Ren'ai Club Sapphire
original_name: 宅配恋愛倶楽部サファイア
source:
Girl loves a boy, but can't confess her feelings. She even leaves him a love letter, but he fails to receive it. Girls asks her friends how she can approach her love in a natural way, and they come to an idea to pretend to be love service company and send her as a prostitute to his house as a new customer free trial.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
少女爱上了一名少年，却始终无法表白。她甚至写下情书，可对方并没有收到。少女向朋友们请教如何自然地接近心上人，众人最终想出一个主意：假装经营恋爱服务公司，再以新客户免费体验为名，把她作为应召女郎送到少年家中。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
